context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend refactoring verified. Key changes: 1) Pydantic models moved to models.py (UserCreate, TransactionCreate, ChatMessage, etc.). 2) Auth functions moved to services/auth.py (hash_password, verify_password, create_token, get_current_user, get_admin_user). 3) Notification functions moved to services/notifications.py (create_notification, notify_admins). 4) Scoring functions moved to services/scoring.py (process_user_scoring, process_user_reminders). 5) Constants moved to config.py (CRYPTO_WALLETS, CHATBOT_FAQ, SUPPORT_EMAILS, RESTRICTED_BANK_TRANSFER_EMAILS). 6) SafeJSONResponse and MongoJSONEncoder in config.py for MongoDB ObjectId handling. 7) create_admin_notification remains in server.py (different signature with email notification support).
